Messages.Author: hel...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
I just had lots of fun with Bianca with two Ghoul Retainers and a
flamethrower (in a rush deck). Lots of nice burnings. It won't happen
again with the same players of course, because they will just block me
getting the Ghoul Retainers no matter what the cost. I think I'll
change it to using Gangrel, as they can always get what they want :-)

A couple of questions about Ghoul Retainers;
- Can they use weapons that the vampire steals with first strike (I
stole a Femur of Toomler, and then both Ghouls hit with it)- ouch?
- Can they use weapons that require a specific clan to use (eg. Sword
of Judgement)? Does this change if the vampire is not of the
appropriate clan?
- Can they use weapons that specify the "vampire using this
weapon ... " (empahisis on "vampire" - eg. Femur of Toomler)?

While burning lots of vamps, I didn't get any VP, due to kindred
restructures and the like, but hey, that's the nature of the beast.

Cheers,

Andrew.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <8mo694$b67$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

hel...@my-deja.com wrote:
> A couple of questions about Ghoul Retainers;
> - Can they use weapons that the vampire steals with first strike (I
> stole a Femur of Toomler, and then both Ghouls hit with it)- ouch?

No. Weapons stolen cannot be used the round they are stolen.
[6.4.5] Strike Effects
http://www.white-wolf.com/VTES/rulebook.html

> - Can they use weapons that require a specific clan to use (eg. Sword
> of Judgement)?

No. If it requires a clan to use the weapon, no vampire of another
clan, and no ally or retainer may use the weapon.

If it only has a clan symbol on the left, like Femur of Toomler, it
only requires that clan to bring the equipment into play. Once in
play, the equipment can be used by any vampire, ally, or Ghoul Retainer.

> Does this change if the vampire is not of the appropriate clan?

No. Still cannot use it.

> - Can they use weapons that specify the "vampire using this
> weapon ... " (empahisis on "vampire" - eg. Femur of Toomler)?

Femur says minion with this equipment, so not sure why you used that as
your example. But no, if it specifies vampire, the Ghoul Retainer may
not use it.

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra

Not to be a picky bastard, but...ok...to be a picky bastard, but the
quoted rule actually says nothing about retainers. Here's the exact
wording of the rule:

"The equipment may not be used by the stealing minion during the current
round of combat."

Technically, a Ghoul Retainer is _not_ the stealing minion. In fact, the
only criteria that is imposed on whether a Ghoul Retainer can use a
weapon is that the "...controlling vampire is not using [the weapon]
during that round of combat," which is very true in this case. According
to the letter of the law (if not the spirit) you would have to allow
Ghoul Retainers to use a weapon stolen that round.

LSJ, your thoughts?

none of the decks that I might play use Ghoul Retainers and steal
equipment.)

Messages.Body:
Noal McDonald wrote:
> >> The Lasombra <TheLa...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> >> No. Weapons stolen cannot be used the round they are stolen.
> >> [6.4.5] Strike Effects
> >> http://www.white-wolf.com/VTES/rulebook.html
>
> Not to be a picky bastard, but...ok...to be a picky bastard, but the
> quoted rule actually says nothing about retainers. Here's the exact
> wording of the rule:
>
> "The equipment may not be used by the stealing minion during the current
> round of combat."
>
> Technically, a Ghoul Retainer is _not_ the stealing minion.

> LSJ, your thoughts?

The "by the stealing minion" bit was intended to be a foil to the sentence
that preceded it in the printed V:TES rulebook: "The equipment can still be
used on the <round> it is stolen... unless the equipment was stolen with
first strike before it could be used. The stolen equipment may not be used
by the minion stealing it until the next round of combat."

The Revised Rulebook distilled that section down a bit and muddied the
issue (or merely failed to sufficiently clarify the issue, depending on
how you want to view the V:TES printed text).

So, no: Stolen Equipment cannot be used (by a minion or retainer) on the
round in which it was stolen.

(See also the V:TES card text for most Melee Weapons)

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 08 Aug 2000 17:40:49 GMT, Noal McDonald <dhar...@my-deja.com>
wrote:

>"The equipment may not be used by the stealing minion during the current
>round of combat."
>

>Technically, a Ghoul Retainer is _not_ the stealing minion. In fact, the

True, but the Ghoul Retainer has already chosen his strike for that
round, before the weapon actually is in the controlling vampire's
possession.

As I understand it, the actual transfer of the weapon happens during
strike resolution. Normally, all strikes resolve simultaneously, with
the S:CE/Dodge/1st Strike exceptions as noted. If you Fast Hands a
weapon with First Strike, you get their weapon BEFORE their strike
resolves, and so you don't get shot with it. If you Fast Hands it at
inferior, you get the weaponbut STILL get shot with it. However, at
the time you declare strikes, your Ghoul Retainer is forced to declare
'hands for 1', since you don't have the weapon yet.

The original ruling was made in response to someone who wanted to play
Fast Hands/Blur, I believe.

>during that round of combat," which is very true in this case. According
>to the letter of the law (if not the spirit) you would have to allow
>Ghoul Retainers to use a weapon stolen that round.

Fortunately, Ghoul Retainers cannot generate additional strikes, or
another ruling would be necessary. ;)

-- Derek

Here are all the clarifications/errata/rulings on Ghoul Retainer:

Ghoul Retainer - Retainer (2)
Read as "Each round of combat, Ghoul uses hands for 1 damage
or a weapon of the employing minion that the minion is not
presently using." [RTR 19941109]
More than one Ghoul Retainer employed by a Minion could "use"
the same weapon (that the Minion is not using) at the same time.
[TOM 19950921]
The Ghoul is never the "bearer" of the weapon that it uses. Any
side-effect of using the weapon (e.g. Zip Gun, Grenade) is
applied to the Employing minion, as normal. [TOM 19951114]

Per the third one, any restrictions on the employing minion
should apply to the Ghoul as well, but it is not explicitly
stated.

Guess we'll have to wait and see.

Carpe noctem.

Hrm. It seems to me that you could distill it further and remove the
apparent loophole by removing the phrase, "by the stealing minion." The
alternative is to add the phrase, "or its retainers." Either way would
work.

Of course, any last minute revisions to the rulebook have come and gone,
so I suppose a line of errata *cringe* could be added under Ghoul
Retainer. The problem with that is that there's no easy way of stating
that restrictions that apply to the minion, with respect to use of
weapons, also apply to the Ghoul Retainer when you take DotB, Terror
Frenzy, Frenzy, etc. into account.

> (See also the V:TES card text for most Melee Weapons)
